name: v18.1.2
body:
## [18.1.2](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/compare/v18.1.1...v18.1.2) (2026-10-26)


### Bug Fixes

* allow a tab or end of input after a type 6 html block tag name ([#4128](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4128)) ([e09c40d](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/e09c40dfc78aa284a33b11a65bc5e16365069f46))
* apply emphasis flanking and rules 9-10 to the whole delimiter run ([#4145](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4145)) ([5d8e234](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/5d8e2340d78c25c611e1d8215b302fd48f01a601))
* **cli:** await config functions before parsing ([#4138](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4138)) ([3a11ad1](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/3a11ad148397b7628256f5e5d76a454213480c63))
* **cli:** create no-clobber output files atomically ([#4135](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4135)) ([e7c4f64](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/e7c4f64c433c46044fc1aba451ab1c162af704a7))
* do not continue a block quote paragraph from a whitespace-only line ([#4134](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4134)) ([42f34a8](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/42f34a8411c4c14ca2019d69e6b1771f663248f9))
* expand a tab after the block quote marker to the next tab stop ([#4110](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4110)) ([2d3899b](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/2d3899bf7c9e604805c4937b16dd0022480e64ce))
* honor per-call async options when composing hooks ([#4139](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4139)) ([379be9d](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/379be9d65609d4c8c017ac873801573fe77420d4))
* keep a line starting with # but no space in the list item ([#4127](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4127)) ([6b63189](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/6b63189546f7dd842adac65c799c749a00bdd598))
* keep duplicate link definitions in the tokens ([#4132](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4132)) ([2784acc](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/2784acce375c8529071c04ae90a05814d02fad7a))
* keep lazy lines after a list in a nested blockquote ([#4137](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4137)) ([38c7e55](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/38c7e552072e60681369c4ea393787f49fd761bb))
* keep lazy setext underlines in list items as text ([#4126](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4126)) ([398234c](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/398234ccea3b3a4f2353fef1decda29a60f29486))
* render nested image alt formatting as plain text ([#4131](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4131)) ([15f59bb](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/15f59bb88bd462876cbc3af075baf73ec9337e31))
* stop an unclosed inline raw tag from unescaping later blocks ([#4130](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4130)) ([4562b6f](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/4562b6f97988a75a9f20234626f8bbaab72af927))


### Performance Improvements

* ~16% faster parsing by skipping em/strong masking for runs without *, _ or ~ ([#4142](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4142)) ([f0fd3e0](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/f0fd3e0e22c1acc7b5a65ebfe54138af38955e10))
